en.headline: 326 own commits across 10 repos, 3 skill-management releases and 3 model-picker
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode tooling: a sandbox knowledge base, a skill switchboard that reached 1.2.0, and a model picker rewritten down to a single entry point.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-19 with data for every day. Across the period there were 326 own commits plus 646 automated commits, 1 pull request, 9 issue actions (opened, closed or commented) and no reviews. Work concentrated on a set of OpenCode-adjacent tools and documentation repositories, with a smaller share going to upstream projects through issue reports.

### OpenCode tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` was the busiest repository by commit count, with 81 own commits and no automated ones. Nearly all of it was knowledge-base writing: a full table of the 11 skills shipped with OMO slim, the three behaviour-constraint skills added in OMO slim v3.0.5, a new openchamber-storage category covering whether pasted images go to files or the database and the delete-without-shrink plus VACUUM flow, and a planning-capability table. VS Code notes were extended with extensions, keybindings and Copilot/BYOK material, two claims about opening VS Code were verified, and the SenseNova quick reference gained an image skill entry plus a correction that Windows does not need WSL2. One pull request was opened here.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` produced 53 own commits and three releases. The repository gained an Astro plus Starlight bilingual documentation site (English at root, Chinese under /zh-cn) deployed through GitHub Actions, with follow-up fixes aligning the landing page and mobile layout, fixing theme persistence and example rendering, and separating selected from hovered menu states. Release policy and a Chinese release note were documented, and the 1.0.0 release result (npm latest, CI on both platforms, checksums) was recorded. **v1.0.0** shipped on 2026-10-23, followed by v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 on 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-31; 1.1.0 moved all four actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed the diverged-skill summary that counted hidden internal agents and normalised frontmatter booleans.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` had 20 own commits and three releases. Development covered priced accounting, Console calibration and an output v2 layout, documentation of which money source each basis may print, placeholder-based examples, a self-check list for the format side, and moving test prompts into `tests/`. The calibrate command was fixed so it never restamps an old bias with today's date. **v2.0.0** arrived on 2026-10-29 with the priced-accounting formula and Console MCP probing, v3.0.0 on 2026-10-31 cut the model-facing text from roughly 27,400 to about 2,200 tokens and collapsed nine runtime scripts into one `go.mjs` entry point, and v3.0.1 on 2026-11-02 enforced the candidate model menu, per-source chains and a comparing check gate.

### Translation, graphics and reports

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was initialised and built out over 56 own commits: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, then a refactor dropping selection translation in favour of page translation only. Fixes reset page state between runs, added a two-round restore DOM smoke test, required-field validation and JSDoc-based checkJs type checking.

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` used 29 own commits and shipped two releases. Text now wraps automatically with CJK per-character breaking and hard-splitting of overlong Latin words, overflow protection steps font sizes down to a 9px floor, and the CLI became bilingual with an English-default README plus a Chinese version. Korean switched to the Galmuri font because Ark Pixel's ko build lacks Hangul, and a 40-image command gallery was added. **v0.2.0** was the first tagged release on 2026-11-02 and v0.3.0 followed on 2026-11-03 with wrapping and overflow work.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 shipped a skill switchboard that disables skills by writing one global permission rule instead of touching skill files.
v1.2.0 fixed the diverged-skill summary that counted hidden internal agents and normalised frontmatter booleans.
v3.0.0 cut the model-facing text from about 27,400 to roughly 2,200 tokens and reduced nine runtime scripts to one go.mjs entry point.
v3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu, per-source chains and a check gate that re-derives numbers.
v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping with CJK per-character breaking and overflow protection down to a 9px font floor.
Opened pull request #1 in the sandbox knowledge-base repository.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation when the runner process cannot be inspected.

11 own commits of interface and mobile work: a single-button theme switcher with popup menu, a compact icon segmented control, gradient top lines, KPI colour bars, card title bars, zebra striping and navigation underlines, plus real 375/414 viewport fixes for two-line navigation, KPI layout, table wrapping and touch targets. zh.headline: 10 个仓库共 326 次本人提交，技能管理与模型选择器各发多个版本
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode 周边工具：沙箱知识库持续补全，技能开关工具推进到 1.2.0，模型选择器精简为单一入口。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-21 至 2026-11-19，30 天均有数据。期间共有 326 次本人提交，另有 646 次自动提交，1 个拉取请求，9 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有代码评审。工作集中在 OpenCode 相关工具与文档仓库，另有一部分通过 issue 报告反馈到上游项目。

### OpenCode 工具链

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 是提交最多的仓库，81 次本人提交，无自动提交。内容几乎全是知识库写作：OMO slim 随包 11 个 skill 的全表、OMO slim v3.0.5 新增的三个行为约束型 skill、新增 openchamber-storage 类别（粘贴图片存文件还是落库、删除不缩与 VACUUM 流程），以及规划类能力全表。VS Code 笔记补充了扩展、快捷键与 Copilot/BYOK 内容，核实了两条关于打开 VS Code 的说法，SenseNova 速查新增图像 skill 条目并纠正 Windows 不必上 WSL2。此仓库还开了 1 个拉取请求。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 53 次本人提交和 3 个版本。仓库新增 Astro + Starlight 双语文档站（英文在根路径，中文在 /zh-cn），通过 GitHub Actions 构建部署，随后修正了落地页与移动端对齐、主题持久化、示例渲染，并区分菜单选中态与悬停态。发布政策与 1.0.0 中文发布说明写入文档，1.0.0 的发布结果（npm latest、双平台 CI、校验和）也有记录。**v1.0.0** 于 2026-10-23 发布，v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0 分别在 2026-10-29 和 2026-10-31 发布；1.1.0 把四个动作统一为带输出 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，1.2.0 修正了把隐藏内部 agent 计入差异的汇总问题并统一了 frontmatter 布尔值解析。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 有 20 次本人提交和 3 个版本。开发内容包括计价核算、Console 校准与输出 v2 版式，说明每种口径可以打印哪种金额来源，示例改用占位符，补充格式侧自检清单，并把测试提示词移入 `tests/`。calibrate 命令已修复，不会用当天日期重盖旧的偏差值。**v2.0.0** 于 2026-10-29 发布，带来计价公式与 Console MCP 探测；v3.0.0 于 2026-10-31 把模型需阅读的文本从约 27,400 token 压到约 2,200，并把九个运行时脚本合并为单一 `go.mjs` 入口；v3.0.1 于 2026-11-02 强制候选模型菜单、按来源决定链长，并加入重新推导数字的 check 校验。

### 翻译、图形与报告

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从初始化起步，共 56 次本人提交：MV3 骨架、带预设与模型列表的 provider 协议层、术语表流水线、双语页面渲染与分块、熔断与进度显示，随后重构去掉划词翻译只保留整页翻译。修复包括两次运行之间重置页面状态、两轮恢复的 DOM 冒烟测试、必填字段校验，以及基于 JSDoc 的 checkJs 类型检查。

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 有 29 次本人提交和 2 个版本。文本现在自动折行，中日韩字符按字断行，超长拉丁单词按字符硬拆；溢出保护会把字号逐步降到 9px 下限；命令行改为中英双语，README 拆为英文默认版与中文版。韩语改用 Galmuri 字体，因为 Ark Pixel 的 ko 版不含谚文，另新增 40 张命令示例画廊。**v0.2.0** 于 2026-11-02 成为首个正式版本，v0.3.0 于 2026-11-03 带来折行与溢出保护。

`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 有 11 次本人提交，集中在视觉与移动端：主题切换改为单按钮加弹出菜单，再改为紧凑图标分段控件，加入渐变顶线、KPI 色条、卡片标题条、斑马纹与导航下划线，并针对 375/414 真实视口修正导航两行、KPI 收尾、表格换行与触摸目标。资料库清单中的 3 个插件并入，automation 归属得到修正，另补 GitHub 仓库按钮、LICENSE 与 .gitattributes。`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 同样有 11 次本人提交，把 OpenChamber 功能移植为 DSH 插件与 skill，新增隐藏文件开关、`/init` 项目说明 skill 与 zh-doc-sync 项目 skill，并补中文 README、AGENTS 本地翻译与待办清单。

### 个人主页、博客与上游反馈

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 63 次本人提交，另有 646 次自动提交。工作主要是测量与 CI 探针：实测并记录 deepseek 三个 `reasoning_effort` 取值的用量，临时探针 workflow 用真实提示词跑了几轮后删除，minimax 免费线路改为发送 `reasoning_effort=low`，因为 `none` 会返回 400 而省略参数会思考到超时。codemap 基线改指向 rebase 后的提交。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 有 2 次本人提交，补充 OpenChamber 会话保留提示与 DSH 统计页上下文增量 bug 的截图。

上游方面，`openchamber/openchamber` 有 6 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），包括设置页 MCP 未列出运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器、会话保留提示仍在描述旧的“仅归档会话”复选框、引用卡片箭头在引用消息不在已加载历史时无反应，以及文件视图中跨行号拖动评论不可靠。`microsoft/PowerToys` 报告了快捷键指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException，`anomalyco/opencode` 则评论了 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行的功能请求。

v1.2.0 修正了把隐藏内部 agent 计入差异的汇总问题，并统一 frontmatter 布尔值解析。
v3.0.0 把模型需阅读的文本从约 27,400 token 降到约 2,200，并把九个运行时脚本合并为一个 go.mjs 入口。
v3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单、按来源决定链长，并加入重新推导数字的 check 校验。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行（中日韩按字断行）与溢出保护，字号最低降到 9px。
在沙箱知识库仓库开了拉取请求 #1。
报告设置页 MCP 未列出 OpenCode 在运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告快捷键指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException，且无法检查 runner 进程时界面无任何显示。
